subject: Creativity
title: Meditation and Imagination: Clearing the Creative Stage
description: A fast breakdown of Meditation and Imagination: Clearing the Creative Stage for builders.

hook.text: Meditation empties the stage. Imagination fills it. Combining both produces a mind that creates with clarity.

buildup.text: Open monitoring meditation improves divergent thinking — the ability to generate many possible ideas.

discovery.text: Focused attention meditation improves convergent thinking — finding one correct answer to a defined problem.

twist.text: Different meditation styles enhance different creative abilities.

climax.text: Regular meditators show thicker cortex in brain regions linked to imagination, attention, and emotional regulation.

punchline.text: Meditation doesn't empty the mind. It trains it to imagine better.

quiz.question: Which meditation style specifically improves divergent thinking?
